title: Schedule of Wear and Defect Replacement Benefits — Brake Service Warranties
content:
The replacement benefits of Brake Service Warranties are set per line in the three schedules below.

### Schedule 1 — warranty wear replacements

| Brake service line | Pads of a wear replacement free | Labor for a warranty wear replacement, per axle | Warranty wear replacements per job |
|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Value Brake Service 12-Month/12,000-Mile Warranty | No | 0.00 | 0 |
| Crestline Standard Brake Service 24-Month/24,000-Mile Warranty | No | 0.00 | 0 |
| Crestline Ceramic Brake Service 36-Month/36,000-Mile Warranty | Yes | 69.99 | 1 |
| Crestline Premium Ceramic Lifetime Pad Warranty | Yes | 139.99 | unlimited |
| Crestline Complete Brake Service Lifetime Pad Warranty | Yes | 0.00 | unlimited |
| Crestline Severe-Duty Brake Service 12-Month/12,000-Mile Warranty | No | 0.00 | 0 |

A count of 0 warranty wear replacements per job means wear is not covered on that line. A labor figure of 0.00 means no labor is charged for a warranty wear replacement; a positive figure is the labor charged per axle for one.

### Schedule 2 — labor on a defect replacement

| Brake service line | Defect labor free within, calendar months from the job date | Defect labor free within, miles from the job odometer |
|---|---|---|
| Crestline Value Brake Service 12-Month/12,000-Mile Warranty | 3 | 3000 |
| Crestline Standard Brake Service 24-Month/24,000-Mile Warranty | 6 | 6000 |
| Crestline Ceramic Brake Service 36-Month/36,000-Mile Warranty | 12 | 12000 |
| Crestline Premium Ceramic Lifetime Pad Warranty | 12 | 12000 |
| Crestline Complete Brake Service Lifetime Pad Warranty | 24 | 24000 |
| Crestline Severe-Duty Brake Service 12-Month/12,000-Mile Warranty | 3 | 3000 |

Labor for a defect replacement is free within the calendar months shown, counted from the date of the original job, and within the miles shown, counted from the odometer of the original job.

### Schedule 3 — premature wear on a limited warranty

| Brake service line | Premature wear threshold, percent of the warranty miles | What premature wear earns |
|---|---|---|
| Crestline Value Brake Service 12-Month/12,000-Mile Warranty | 50 | pads free, labor charged |
| Crestline Standard Brake Service 24-Month/24,000-Mile Warranty | 50 | pads free, labor charged |
| Crestline Ceramic Brake Service 36-Month/36,000-Mile Warranty | 50 | pads and labor free |
| Crestline Premium Ceramic Lifetime Pad Warranty | 0 | not applicable |
| Crestline Complete Brake Service Lifetime Pad Warranty | 0 | not applicable |
| Crestline Severe-Duty Brake Service 12-Month/12,000-Mile Warranty | 50 | pads free, labor charged |

The threshold is the share of the line's warranty miles below which wear to minimum is premature wear for a limited warranty; the right-hand column is what premature wear earns on that line.

### Notes on the schedules

- On the Crestline Ceramic Brake Service 36-Month/36,000-Mile Warranty, one warranty wear replacement is allowed per job, with the pads free and labor of 69.99 per axle.
- On the Crestline Premium Ceramic Lifetime Pad Warranty, wear replacements are unlimited, the pads are free and labor is 139.99 per axle; on the Crestline Complete Brake Service Lifetime Pad Warranty, wear replacements are unlimited and both the pads and the labor are free.
- Defect labor runs longest on the Complete line: 24 months and 24000 miles.
